opening.argument: The presentation promotes BitConnectX as an ICO and exchange while showing a $50 coin price, a 5% buyer bonus, and controls for purchasing BCCX. The speaker explicitly says, “you can now buy bitconnect x as well as bitcoin litecoin and bitconnect coin as well,” and directs viewers to log into BitConnect using the same credentials. It also links Bitcoin lending to claimed daily gains, stating that “you earn 1-2% every single day on the bitcoin that you lend out,” while the displayed page describes high-return, guaranteed-interest claims. Although the speaker expresses reservations about the bonus and says they do not currently need to invest, the presentation still invites viewers to buy the ICO coin, hold it for interest, and join BitConnect lending.
